implementation.build_id_zero_effect: ARM is refused; no binding/enable authority is implied by a nonzero value
implementation.core: unchanged deepeye_SYNTHETIC_codec74_fixture at CLOCK_HZ=50000000, BAUD=1000000, SOURCE_REVIEW_HOLD=0
implementation.clock_note: The 1 Mbaud receiver rate is below the existing CLOCK_HZ/16 eligibility limit; the old 5 Mbaud receiver setting is not used.

axi_contract.write_capture: one independent AW slot and one independent W slot; B is held until accepted
axi_contract.read_capture: one R slot; address/data/response are held under RREADY backpressure
axi_contract.busy_rule: BREADY/RREADY do not repeat command effects.
axi_contract.invalid_write_response: SLVERR, no endpoint mutation for unknown, misaligned, read-only, command-high-bit, or partial-strobe writes
axi_contract.invalid_read_response: RDATA=0 and SLVERR for unknown or misaligned offsets
axi_contract.write_only_read: Reading the WO command offset is an unknown read and returns 0/SLVERR.

reset.style: asynchronous assertion and two-cycle synchronous release in the 50 MHz domain
reset.counters: result_id, pop_id, rx_total, and discard_count return to zero
reset.epoch_note: BUILD_ID and retained local fixture epoch are not global BOOT identity or authorization

0.name: CANCEL
0.meaning: idle/stopped; source_cancel asserted; profile/transport gates low

1.name: ARM_WAIT
1.meaning: ARM accepted; the next cycle is the one-cycle capture rearm cycle

2.name: ARM_SETTLE
2.meaning: rearm passed; profile/transport gates remain low

4.name: CAPTURED
4.meaning: four raw lanes captured; sequential BIND is permitted

5.name: BINDING
5.meaning: one association descriptor is held until assoc_ready or CANCEL

6.name: WAIT_RESULT
6.meaning: waiting for actual core result and exact accepted wire-byte total

7.name: RESULT_READY
7.meaning: one PS-visible result is held for exact ACK

8.name: WAIT_CORE_IDLE
8.meaning: result_ready was pulsed once; wait for result_valid to deassert

9.name: COMPLETE
9.meaning: four results acknowledged; no automatic rearm or fifth lane

fault_bits.0x00000001: capture fault event or capture sequence exhaustion
fault_bits.0x00000002: 4096-byte FIFO overflow event with no eligible simultaneous POP
fault_bits.0x00000004: actual UART RX framing error event
fault_bits.0x00000020: successful-result accepted-byte total exceeded before+trace_result_bytes or 32-bit sum overflowed
fault_bits.0x00000040: successful-result accepted-byte total was short after RX became idle
fault_bits.0x00000080: a 32-bit global counter would otherwise wrap

sticky_fault_semantics: Fault bits are OR-latched. Any newly observed fault cancels the active path and clears consumption freshness. CLEAR_FAULT succeeds only from CANCEL with actual core quiescence, RX idle, and no visible/core result. It does not auto-ARM or reset IDs, FIFO, discard, or RX counters.

status_bits.bit0: armed: state is one of ARM_WAIT through WAIT_CORE_IDLE
status_bits.bit2: RX busy: receiver busy or an unretired RX byte is pending
status_bits.bit4: result valid: PS-visible result held in RESULT_READY

registers.fields: 31:0 total accepted UART RX wire-byte count; saturating/faulting, never wrapping
31:0 last visible result id; increments once per accepted result
5:0 core trace_result_bytes for the last visible result; 31:6 zero
3:0 core last_refusal_code captured with the last visible result; 31:4 zero. It is not a command-error code.
31:0 RX accepted-byte total captured at the last successful BIND
31:0 actual UART RX stat_aborted; partial cancels are counted by the unchanged receiver
bit0 live core capture_fault_event; bit1 core capture_sequence_exhausted; 31:2 zero
bit8 FIFO-peek valid; 7:0 head byte; 31:9 zero. Read is non-destructive.
7:0 last known command code; 31:8 zero. A known command updates this even when refused; an unknown command does not.
31:0 RX accepted-byte total at visibility of the last result
7:0 command; 31:8 must be zero. This offset is not readable.
31:0 arm_tag; consuming ARM requires nonzero and strictly greater than the last accepted tag
30:0 origin_qpc_ns high word; bit31 reserved and rejected by ARM
1:0 sample_channel; 31:2 reserved and rejected by PUSH
15:0 opaque signed raw sample; 31:16 reserved. Invalid samples require exactly 0x0000 padding.
30:0 sample uint63 tick high word; bit31 reserved and rejected by PUSH
3:0 opaque quality {source_fault,held,saturated,valid}; 31:4 reserved and rejected by PUSH
9:0 acquisition remainder_ns, accepted only as 0..999; 31:10 reserved and rejected by BIND
30:0 source QPC_ns high word; bit31 reserved and rejected by BIND
9:0 source remainder_ns, accepted only as 0..999; 31:10 reserved and rejected by BIND
7:0 fixture-local epoch; 31:8 reserved and rejected by BIND
15:0 fixture-local frame sequence; 31:16 reserved and rejected by BIND
31:0 exact expected result id for ACK

staging_freshness.arm: 0x100,0x104,0x108 must all have been written since reset, last ARM, CANCEL, or fault
staging_freshness.push: 0x110,0x114,0x118,0x11c,0x120 must all have been written since reset, last ARM/PUSH, CANCEL, or fault
staging_freshness.bind: 0x130,0x134,0x138,0x13c,0x140,0x144,0x148,0x14c,0x150,0x154 must all have been written since reset, last ARM/BIND, CANCEL, or fault
staging_freshness.ack: 0x160 freshness is consumed only by successful ACK
staging_freshness.pop: 0x164 freshness is consumed only by successful POP
staging_freshness.refusal: A refused known command does not consume its staging; a simultaneous independent fault/cancel may invalidate freshness.

commands.name: ARM
commands.success_gate: CANCEL state, fresh arm staging, BUILD_ID nonzero, tag nonzero/greater, uint63 origin, quiescent core, idle RX, empty FIFO, no visible/core result, no sticky fault
commands.effect: snapshot tag/origin; clear scan/result transient state; enter ARM_WAIT; source_cancel deasserts then one capture_rearm occurs on the next cycle

commands.name: PUSH
commands.success_gate: ARMED, fresh sample staging, low reserved bits clear, channel equals next 0..3, all lanes share one uint63 tick, legal quality, invalid raw data zero
commands.effect: one-cycle sample_strobe; retain the lane and consume sample staging; the fourth push enters CAPTURED

commands.name: BIND
commands.success_gate: CAPTURED after four lanes, fresh association staging, next channel 0..3, exact reconstructed acquisition/source times, legal flags, strictly increasing fixture frame sequence, no result/core/RX activity
commands.effect: hold one association and all descriptor fields until actual assoc_ready or CANCEL; capture RX_total_before

commands.name: ACK
commands.success_gate: RESULT_READY, actual core result_valid, exact fresh expected result id, nonzero result id
commands.effect: pulse fixture_result_ready once, hide the held result, enter WAIT_CORE_IDLE

commands.name: CANCEL
commands.success_gate: always accepted as a known command
commands.effect: drive actual source_cancel, drop profile/transport gates and assoc_valid, invalidate result/scan capability and freshness; retain raw FIFO, counters, and partial-outcome flags

commands.name: CLEAR_FAULT
commands.success_gate: CANCEL, core quiescent, RX idle, no visible/core result
commands.effect: clear sticky faults only; no auto-ARM and no ID/FIFO/counter reset

commands.name: CLEAR_FIFO
commands.success_gate: CANCEL, core quiescent, RX idle, no visible/core result, discard-count addition will not wrap
commands.effect: count and discard all 4096-or-fewer retained bytes; reset FIFO pointers/count; add the discarded count to cumulative discard_count; preserve rx_total, pop_id, and result_id

commands.name: POP
commands.success_gate: CANCEL or COMPLETE, fresh expected pop id, nonempty FIFO, expected == pop_id+1, pop_id not 0xffffffff
commands.effect: remove exactly one raw byte once; increment pop_id; allow one simultaneous RX replacement when full

command_response_rule: B=OKAY only for an accepted known command or a valid RW staging write. B=SLVERR for every invalid/unimplemented write and every refused known command. There is no hidden timeout, automatic retry, automatic ARM, or automatic rearm.

source_time_rules.arm_origin: uint63 origin_qpc_ns, with bit63 reserved zero
source_time_rules.acquisition: checked origin + acq_tick_us*1000 + acq_rem_ns == retained raw-lane uint63 tick
source_time_rules.source: checked origin + source_tick_us*1000 + source_rem_ns == staged uint63 source QPC_ns
source_time_rules.held: for a valid sample, held must equal (source_qpc_ns < acquisition_qpc_ns); source must not exceed acquisition
source_time_rules.invalid_placeholder: assoc_source_qpc_ns, source_tick_us, and source_remainder_ns are driven as all-zero wire placeholders; staged low fields are not emitted
source_time_rules.identity_limit: session/index/epoch/seq remain fixture-local values, not authenticated Root/BOOT identity

result_rules.trace_result_bytes_meaning: exact total wire bytes emitted by the unchanged existing block: 14 + payload_meta_bytes
result_rules.success_visibility: actual core result_valid, result_error=0, RX idle, nonoverlapping 32-bit sum, and RX_total_after == RX_total_before + result_bytes
result_rules.refused_visibility: actual core result_valid, result_error!=0, and RX idle; actual accepted partial bytes are retained and result_rx_end records the observed total; an unchanged-core serializer wire fault is the visible result_error=6/result_bytes=0 refusal, not a success or hidden retry
result_rules.excess_or_missing: For result_error=0, excess accepted bytes or an idle short total cancel and latch a sticky fault; no result is made visible.
result_rules.backpressure: Visible result fields and id remain unchanged until exact ACK, CANCEL, or fault.
result_rules.ack_limit: ACK never regenerates or repairs wire bytes.

raw_fifo_rules.content: Actual UART RX bytes only; no packet parser, CRC repair, or second encoder.
raw_fifo_rules.read: 0x070 is non-destructive and bit8 valid is separate from byte value 0x00.
raw_fifo_rules.pop: Explicit fresh 0x164 and command 8 only; one item once.
raw_fifo_rules.full: With no eligible simultaneous POP, a newly delivered byte at count 4096 is not overwritten: overflow bit 0x00000002 is latched and the active path cancels.
raw_fifo_rules.concurrent: When full and RX delivers in the same cycle as an eligible POP, one item is removed and the new byte occupies the freed slot; count remains 4096.
raw_fifo_rules.pointers: FIFO pointers wrap modulo 4096; byte count is separately 13-bit and never silently overflows.
